gui.method: Actual local browser controls on the public single-operation application; current PNG also checked through its authenticated API

checks.check: Fresh public app has an empty result and no list of past runs
Generation submitted via browser button, output and parameters visible
Original PNG bytes match current image SHA256
Screenshot contains only controls and current result; no paths or session URL
Same bookmark authenticates after a real server restart
Restarted server exposes an empty current result and old PNG returns 404

limitations: Smoke timing is a functional observation, not an additional controlled quality benchmark.
Full standalone report browser layout is not verified; DOM mechanics and embedded image bytes are checked separately.

manager.status: PASS within stated checks; native window interaction still needs review

server_lifecycle.method: Backend commands against actual frozen EXE, not native UI controls

real_worker.method: Authenticated HTTP on bundled server, real bundled worker and native engine; not a native-window click test

native_window.reason: Window capture did not complete; no native button or folder-dialog result is claimed

limitations: No clean-machine installation test; existing models and installed CUDA were reused.

Only the small cudart package was transferred from NVIDIA in the recorded download check; model, engine and cuBLAS transfer paths use the same checked downloader and pinned metadata, with local HTTP failure/resume tests.
The packaged server and worker were tested through authenticated HTTP and their program controller, not by clicking the native Manager buttons.
Optional external launch wrappers are supported only by the source route; the Windows package is qualified for its direct bundled worker.
Worker timing is a functional observation, not an additional quality or speed benchmark.
No independent review or full offline report layout validation.
